institution: IIIT Sri City (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Sri City)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: Highest-rated category (4.2/5); rigorous, well-structured curriculum with strong emphasis on core computer science subjects; several professors described as excellent and genuinely supportive.
Around 92-93% of students placed, especially in CS backgrounds; average packages reported in the 15-18 LPA range in some comparisons; strong industry connections noted for a relatively new institute.
Classrooms equipped with projectors and ACs; academic block well maintained; clean, modern, minimal aesthetic even while campus is still developing.
Quiet, peaceful campus located inside Sri City away from urban noise, helping students focus on studies and projects.

key_negative_themes.notes: Lowest-rated category by a wide margin (2.3/5); fees seen as high relative to facilities, with students feeling some things 'do not match the amount we pay.'
Campus still developing; described as lacking fancy buildings, with limited sports and recreational facilities; some reviews rate infrastructure as merely average.
Location inside Sri City, away from a big city, makes campus life feel isolated to some students, even though it aids focus.
Faculty quality described as mixed — some genuinely good and supportive, others reported as relying heavily on reading slides with less engagement.
As a newer institute, it is still building its industry reputation and position relative to older, more established IIITs like IIIT Pune.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Balanced academics with decent placements and calm campus — modern but minimal classrooms, 92-93% students placed
For me the value for money is medium, fees are on the higher side, some things do not match the amount we pay
Quiet campus, strong academics, growth depends on self effort — infrastructure decent but not extraordinary
It was a decent experience — average college in terms of infrastructure, nothing great, wouldn't give it above 3
IIIT Sri City is a newer institute with modern infrastructure, strong industry connection, and excellent placements around 15-18 LPA average

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Sri City is positive overall, anchored by strong academics and solid placement outcomes for a relatively young institute. However, value for money stands out as a clear weak point, alongside a still-developing campus and some inconsistency in faculty engagement — patterns common among newer-generation IIITs that are still building out infrastructure and industry reputation.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
